summary: Verified iteration_2 polish fix: SuccessDialog Home/Play Again/Next Level all dismiss cleanly with no transient double DOM tree observed across find-object, count-animals, same-different, and bigger-smaller games (shape-puzzle skipped per request note due to drag-drop). Regression: Tic-Tac-Toe end-to-end works (X wins top row -> 'Player X wins!' banner -> Play Again resets board). Home lists 6 game cards + Progress card. No console errors captured across all navigations.
action_items: Non-blocking code-quality: Fix consistency of iteration_2 polish. In find-object.tsx and count-animals.tsx a shared `goHome` callback calls setShowSuccess(false) before router.replace('/'). In bigger-smaller.tsx (line 139), same-different.tsx (line 158), and shape-puzzle.tsx (line 198), the SuccessDialog's onHome prop is an inline handler that only does `router.replace('/')` without setShowSuccess(false). Functionally still works because router.replace unmounts the screen (and thus the Modal), so no visible glitch was observed in testing. For code consistency and defense-in-depth, refactor these three to reuse a `goHome` useCallback that sets setShowSuccess(false) first (mirroring find-object/count-animals pattern) and pass it to both GameTopBar and SuccessDialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Inline goHome handler on SuccessDialog in bigger-smaller.tsx / same-different.tsx / shape-puzzle.tsx does not call setShowSuccess(false) before router.replace('/'), unlike GameTopBar onHome in the same files. Duplicated intent; consolidate into a single useCallback to avoid regression drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested polish + regression scope (4/4 games verified for dialog polish; shape-puzzle skipped per instructions; TTT regression passed; home layout intact)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 polish (setShowSuccess(false) before router.replace) has been verified functionally across find-object, count-animals, same-different, bigger-smaller. Shape-puzzle was not exercised end-to-end (drag/drop headless-mouse limitation). All SuccessDialog primary buttons (success-home-button, success-restart-button, success-next-button) dismiss the modal cleanly with no double-tree flash and no console errors. Note: 3 of the 5 games (bigger-smaller, same-different, shape-puzzle) still have inline handlers on SuccessDialog's onHome that omit the explicit setShowSuccess(false); this is a code-consistency issue rather than a functional bug because router.replace unmounts the whole screen including the Modal.
rca_of_issue: N/A — polish fix verified. Observed dialog dismissal within <100ms after tapping Home in all four verified games; router.replace('/') then navigates back to the home listing with all 6 game cards + Progress card visible and no console errors.
